def R(y_orig, y_new):
    err_fine = abs(y_new - 1.0)
    err_coarse = abs(y_orig - 1.0)
    if err_coarse == 0.0:
        return err_fine == 0.0
    ratio = err_fine / err_coarse
    expected_ratio = (0.5)**2  # second-order convergence: h^2 / (h/2)^2 = 1/4
    return 0.2 <= ratio <= 0.6  # allows some numerical tolerance around 0.25
